messages.subject: Installing rhdfs
parts:
Installing rhdfs is tricky because of the need to set HADOOP_CMD and the way sudo works.  Here is how you do it:

sudo HADOOP_CMD=/usr/bin/hadoop R CMD INSTALL --byte-compile rhdfs rhdfs_1.0.5.tar.gz
